_meta.purpose: Per-book parameters for tools/apospasma.mjs -- the excerpt-PDF button that replaces the plain 'Απόσπασμα (PDF)' text link for every title that has a PDF excerpt (content/press.json's excerpt.pdf). See plan.md for the full spec and what remains.
technique: Border art: Z-Image-Turbo, portrait 832x1248 (2:3), white/light linework on a black ground, no text in the prompt (D8 -- diffusion Greek is gibberish). Saved to tools/apospasma-src/<id>-border-raw.webp.

tools/apospasma.mjs keys the raw render's luminance to alpha (same method as imprintMark() in tools/covers.mjs / D15's imprint.webp), composites 'label_el' + 'title_el' as opentype.js vector glyph outlines in 'font_file' (never diffusion text), and writes public/apospasma/<id>.webp -- white artwork, real alpha channel, no baked colour.
The site recolours live: CSS mask-image: url(...) + background-color: var(--book-text), exactly how .head__imprint recolours public/imprint.webp. Never bake a colour into the asset.
font_dirs: tools/fonts/ (GFS Didot, Literata -- already licensed, D1)
_meta.font_verification: Real cmap glyph-coverage check (fontTools), not Google Fonts' CSS subset claims -- most 'editorial serif' fonts people assume are Greek-capable are not (see plan.md §2 for the full tested list and why each of the 13 assigned here passed).
